rules.name: combined-var-02-slices-uat
rules.sql: SELECT a.tenant_id, '[' || a.business_unit || ']' AS business_unit_quoted, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT a.subportfolio) AS subportfolios, count(DISTINCT a.invenio_product_code) AS products, min(a.value_date) AS min_value_date, max(a.value_date) AS max_value_date, min(a.settlement_date) AS min_settle_date, max(a.settlement_date) AS max_settle_date, max(v.value_date) AS valuation_value_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.value_date = v.value_date) AS rows_at_valuation_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.value_date IS NULL OR a.settlement_date IS NULL) AS null_dates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.subportfolio IS NULL OR a.invenio_product_code IS NULL) AS null_keys, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.future_continuation_series IS NULL OR a.future_continuation_series = '') AS no_future_series, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.option_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND a.option_continuation_series <> '') AS option_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(a.delta, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(a.gamma, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(a.vega, 0) = 0) AS all_greeks_zero, min(a.created_timestamp) AS first_loaded, max(a.created_timestamp) AS last_loaded, string_agg(DISTINCT a.created_by, ',') AS loaded_by FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a LEFT JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND UPPER(v.business_unit) = UPPER(a.business_unit) GROUP BY a.tenant_id, a.business_unit ORDER BY a.tenant_id, a.business_unit

SELECT tenant_id, '[' || business_unit || ']' AS business_unit_quoted, '[' || status || ']' AS status_quoted, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) AS levels, count(DISTINCT subportfolio) AS subportfolios, min(created_timestamp) AS first_loaded, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_changed, string_agg(DISTINCT created_by, ',') AS loaded_by FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table GROUP BY tenant_id, business_unit, status ORDER BY tenant_id, business_unit, status

WITH acct AS ( SELECT subportfolio, value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu ), agg AS ( SELECT DISTINCT aggregation_level, subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE' ), joined AS ( SELECT acct.value_date FROM acct WHERE acct.subportfolio IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM agg) ), val AS ( SELECT max(value_date) AS value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = UPPER(:bu) ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM acct) AS acct_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT subportfolio) FROM acct) AS acct_subportfolios, (SELECT count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) FROM agg) AS agg_levels, (SELECT count(DISTINCT subportfolio) FROM agg) AS agg_subportfolios, (SELECT count(*) FROM joined) AS acct_rows_in_agg, (SELECT count(DISTINCT value_date) FROM joined) AS matched_value_dates, (SELECT count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) FROM agg) * (SELECT count(DISTINCT value_date) FROM joined) * 10 AS expected_output_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE UPPER(TRIM(subportfolio)) IN (SELECT UPPER(TRIM(subportfolio)) FROM agg)) AS loose_rows_in_agg, (SELECT value_date FROM val) AS valuation_value_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM val)) AS acct_rows_at_valuation_date

SELECT a.subportfolio, count(*) AS row_count, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g.status, ',') FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table g WHERE g.subportfolio = a.subportfolio AND LOWER(g.business_unit) = :bu) AS status_in_agg_for_bu, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g.business_unit, ',') FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table g WHERE g.subportfolio = a.subportfolio) AS bus_in_agg_table FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a WHERE LOWER(a.business_unit) = :bu AND a.subportfolio NOT IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY a.subportfolio ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 50

WITH fs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT future_continuation_series AS s FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND future_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND future_continuation_series <> '' ), os AS ( SELECT DISTINCT option_continuation_series AS s FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND option_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND option_continuation_series <> '' ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fs) AS future_series, (SELECT count(*) FROM fs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.var_cont_price_change_table p WHERE p.cont_month = fs.s)) AS future_series_missing_price, (SELECT count(*) FROM os) AS option_series, (SELECT count(*) FROM os WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.var_cont_vol_change_table v WHERE v.cont_month = os.s)) AS option_series_missing_vol

WITH val AS ( SELECT max(settlement_date) AS settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = UPPER(:bu) ), pr AS ( SELECT min(settlement_date) AS d0, max(settlement_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT settlement_date) AS days FROM opera.var_cont_price_change_table ), vo AS ( SELECT min(settlement_date) AS d0, max(settlement_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT settlement_date) AS days FROM opera.var_cont_vol_change_table ), fc AS ( SELECT max(settlement_date) AS d1 FROM opera.future_cont_series_table ), oc AS ( SELECT max(settlement_date) AS d1 FROM opera.option_cont_series_table ) SELECT (SELECT settlement_date FROM val) AS valuation_settlement_date, pr.d0 AS price_first, pr.d1 AS price_last, pr.days AS price_days, vo.d0 AS vol_first, vo.d1 AS vol_last, vo.days AS vol_days, fc.d1 AS future_cont_series_last, oc.d1 AS option_cont_series_last, (SELECT settlement_date FROM val) - pr.d1 AS price_days_behind, (SELECT settlement_date FROM val) - vo.d1 AS vol_days_behind FROM pr, vo, fc, oc

WITH val AS ( SELECT max(settlement_date) AS settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = UPPER(:bu) ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view) AS mult_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu) AS acct_products, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.cloned_product_master_table WHERE curr_mult_type = 'division' AND constant_curr_mult <> 1) AS const_curr_mult_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.product_busdays_table WHERE is_holiday = 1 AND value_date >= (SELECT settlement_date FROM val) - 400) AS holiday_rows_in_lookback, (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.product_busdays_table) AS busdays_last_date

SELECT 'helper_var_accounting_report' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count, min(created_timestamp) AS first_loaded, max(created_timestamp) AS last_loaded, string_agg(DISTINCT created_by, ',') AS loaded_by FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report UNION ALL SELECT 'helper_var_mult_factor_view', count(*), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), string_agg(DISTINCT created_by, ',') FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view UNION ALL SELECT 'var_aggregation_level_table', count(*), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), string_agg(DISTINCT created_by, ',') FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_product_master_table', count(*), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), string_agg(DISTINCT created_by, ',') FROM opera.cloned_product_master_table

SELECT table_name, table_type, CASE WHEN table_type = 'BASE TABLE' THEN (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as c from %I.%I', table_schema, table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint END AS exact_rows FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name ~ '(helper_var|curr_mult|product_master|var_product_code|underlying_list|vol_id_table|cont_series|^var_)' ORDER BY table_name

expect.reason: F1: the accounting table holds rows
F2: the aggregation table holds rows
F1: the accounting slice for the business unit has rows (spelling of business_unit, see acct-by-bu)
F2: an ACTIVE aggregation slice for the business unit exists (spelling of business_unit and status, see agg-by-bu-status)
F3: accounting subportfolios join to ACTIVE aggregation subportfolios (see unmatched-subportfolios, loose_rows_in_agg)
the report has rows. If this passes and the API still fails, the pod uses a different config or data (read the service log line generateCombinedVar)
F4: accounting rows exist for the current valuation date, otherwise the data is a stale snapshot (see load-evidence)
F6: every future continuation series has price history
F6: every option continuation series has vol history
F7: price scenarios reach the valuation settlement date
F7: vol scenarios reach the valuation settlement date
F5: helper_var_mult_factor_view is filled, otherwise every delta and gamma is zero (see source-objects)
F8: product holidays exist inside the 260 day lookback
